stage1.impression: A night view from the kerb through a shopfront into a long, dark timber-and-concrete bar, with a sodium-warm bar run, pendants and two spot-lit speakers far at the back. It reads as a competent archviz render rather than a photograph: the etched name is a flat, pinkish, cropped half-word floating on the glass, cold blue globe lamps are the loudest colour in the frame, a clipped white disc hangs mid-air like a moon, and the blackened-steel facade is a blotchy grunge texture. A magazine would not run it as a specific place yet; it reads as a generic dark bar seen through a window, and the EARF pair is too small and too dim to be the hero.

blocking_9: The etched name must sit whole in frame and read as acid-etched glass (a faint frosting catching street light), not a translucent pink vinyl overlay cut off by the left edge
The only saturated colour must come from EARF's speakers and lamps in their Smoke tint; the Orbs currently glow cold blue (b > r) from a neutral liner under a 2900 K white balance
The EARF pair on the altar must read at a glance: lum_median >= 45 on each cabinet and large enough in frame to show tint and light through the acrylic (now about 40 x 50 px each at proof scale)
No clipped stray light source in the middle of the glazing (the white disc at about 650,235)
The blackened steel must read as real blackened steel (near-black, soft uneven sheen, brownish patina, sharp edges) rather than a high-contrast grunge decal
The frosted lightbox with the dancer's silhouette must actually read as a glowing frosted panel with a fogged figure; it currently reads as a smudged shower curtain
The shopfront glass should behave like glass at night from the kerb: faint, clean reflections of the street and the kerb, not invisible in some places and a bright disc in others
The floor must read as a real polished surface without the mottled, low-resolution blotch pattern

defects.what: Etched name on glass reads as flat translucent pink letters (lum_median 75.7, r 94 g 71 b 66), far brighter than an emission of 0.04 should give, and cropped by the frame's left edge so only part of the word shows
Clipped neutral-white disc floating mid-room (clip_pct 30, rgb 180/182/184): a street lamp reflection or bare source seen in the glazing; reads as a moon or a CG point light
Orb table lamp liner glows cold blue (rgb 177/188/203), the most saturated colour in the frame; repeated as five identical blue globes across the room (575,438 rgb 138/158/181)
Left altar speaker underlit (lum_median 38.7) and tiny; tint and the light through its acrylic do not read
Steel pier has a blotchy, high-contrast grunge pattern of white flecks; reads as a game texture, not blackened steel
Same grunge decal repeated on the right facade's steel panels; tiling read
Frosted lightbox glows unevenly (lum 29-105, dark smudge at top, bright foot), no readable dancing figure; looks like a shower curtain
A pale pinkish blank panel (lum_median 120) beside the lightbox draws the eye with no content
Full-height mullion post slices the room view at the left third, through the table and the bar's front
Floor shows a mottled, blurry blotch pattern (like a stretched low-res texture) and a hard-edged slab of spill light
Ceiling band near-black and dead (lum_median 4, crush 27.6%)
Dome pendants read as plain white bowls, untinted; the Smoke tint does not show
Stall riser below the glass is a dark, flat-lit band with the same grunge pattern

changes.problem: The frame's subject, the name etched into the glass, is cut off at the left edge, while a steel pier and the dark right-hand facade take up a third of the frame and show no room.

evidence.measured: name letters run off x=0; pier and right facade span x 770-1200 (36% of width) with room view only through a narrow pink panel

change.to: move left along the kerb to about y 3.4 and back to x -4.0, target [17.0, 3.2, 1.35], keep 35 mm (or 28 mm if the name still crops); place the right-hand pier at the frame's right edge and the whole name inside the left half of the glass, clear of the mullion

changes.expected: The whole etched name reads in the glass, the counter run and the altar pair sit within the central two-thirds, and the pier becomes a dark frame edge instead of a third of the picture.

changes.problem: The Orb lamps glow cold blue and are the most saturated colour in the frame, which makes the room read blue-lit and pulls the eye from the speakers.

evidence.measured: rgb median 177/188/203, delta E2000 16.1 from a warm white #E8E2D8

change.setting: Orb liner glow colour and strength
change.from: glow 0.1529 at a neutral (about 6500 K) colour under a 2900 K white balance
change.to: glow colour 2700 K (about #FFB46B before the smoked tint), glow 0.10; keep the Orb lamp at 0.956 W

changes.expected: The Orbs read as warm smoked globes in the same family as the pendants, glowing rather than shining, with b_median below r_median.

changes.problem: The EARF pair on the altar, the hero, is darker than the bar run and the Orbs, so the tint and the light through its acrylic do not read.

evidence.measured: lum_median 38.7 (right cabinet 638-675: 32.5), against the 45 target; the haze beam above is brighter than the cabinet

change.setting: altar spots and the lamps on the speakers
change.from: altar 2 x spot 1500 W, cone 18 deg; speaker area lamps 1.0 W/m2
change.to: altar spots 1500 W at cone 24 deg aimed at the cabinets' mid-height rather than their tops; speaker area lamps 2.5 W/m2 behind the cabinets so the smoked acrylic and the white batts glow through

changes.expected: Each altar cabinet lifts to lum_median 50-70, with a visible glow through the acrylic edges; the pair becomes the brightest coloured object at the back.

changes.problem: A clipped white disc floats in the middle of the glass, read as a moon or a bare CG point light.

evidence.measured: clip_pct 30.1, rgb 180/182/184 (neutral, not the warm DJ disc #FFD2A0)

change.to: move the street lamp whose reflection lands in the glazing at least 4 m along the kerb out of the reflection path, and drop all three to 120 W at 2700 K; give them a visible sodium-warm reflection only at the glass's outer edges

changes.expected: No hard disc in mid-frame; the glass carries faint warm street reflections at its edges only.

changes.problem: The etched name glows like a translucent pink vinyl overlay instead of acid-etched glass.

evidence.measured: lum_median 75.7, r 94 g 71 b 66: three times the room behind it, flat and evenly filled

change.setting: window's etched name emission and frosting
change.to: emission 0.0; etched frosting roughness 0.6 with 30 % transmission so the letters read only where they scatter the street light and the room's glow, a fine bright rim at the letter edges

changes.expected: The name reads as pale frosted letters a stop or so above the room behind them, with the room still visible through them.

changes.problem: The blackened steel of the shopfront reads as a high-contrast grunge decal with white flecks, tiled across the facade.

evidence.measured: lum p5 12.4 to p95 45.8 with bright speckle blotches; same pattern repeated on 875-1100 panels

change.from: high-contrast mottled patina with pale flecks
change.to: near-black base (about #1E1A17), patina contrast cut to a third, brownish rather than grey, roughness varied 0.35-0.6 for a soft uneven sheen, a thin bright arris at each plate edge

changes.expected: The pier reads as dark blackened steel with soft sheen and crisp edges, no speckle; texture range narrows.

changes.problem: The frosted lightbox with the dancing figure glows unevenly and its figure does not read, so it looks like a smudged curtain.

evidence.measured: lum_median 59, range 76, dark smudge at the top and bright foot (uneven falloff)

change.setting: screens' brightness and frosted acrylic roughness
change.to: lightbox panel 0.9 with an even backlight; frosted roughness 0.45 so the dancer's silhouette is soft but legible

changes.expected: An evenly glowing frosted panel with a recognisable fogged figure, falloff top-to-bottom within about 20 %.

changes.problem: The floor shows a mottled, blurry blotch pattern that reads as a stretched low-resolution texture.

evidence.measured: blotches about 30-60 px across with soft edges, no fine grain at 2x crop

change.to: finer aggregate scale (about a quarter of the current blotch size), contrast halved, polish raised to roughness 0.25 so the pendants and the bar make soft elongated reflections

changes.expected: The floor reads as polished concrete with soft streaked reflections of the bar light, no blotches.

out_of_scope.request: Remove or move the full-height mullion post at x 262-288 that slices the room view
out_of_scope.why: The shopfront's design is fixed; only the camera (c1) can move it out of the key area

out_of_scope.request: Tint the Dome pendants so the Smoke colour reads on them
out_of_scope.why: The Domes' colour is a fixed product attribute; only their light level may change

out_of_scope.request: Make the altar speakers larger in frame by bringing them forward
out_of_scope.why: The altar's position is part of the fixed room design; only the lens or camera can change their size

out_of_scope.request: The pale grey resin horns read like fan blades at this distance
out_of_scope.why: The horn is part of the fixed speaker design
